summary: Reversal Alerts / Stock Unverified badge flow fully verified end-to-end on Nyla Air & Water CRM. Delivery QA-BADGE-0001 (reversed from complete, no stock_restored array) correctly showed the red 'Stock not verified' pill (data-testid stock-unverified-<id>) and the red banner 'stock-unverified-banner' with text '1 reversed delivery has no verified stock restore — the warehouse quantity may still be missing.' and the 'Review' button (stock-unverified-banner-btn). Clicking the pill opened the Stock Audit dialog (stock-audit-dialog) showing 'Verified units restored: none recorded' (stock-audit-verified-restore) and 'Re-add stock now' button (stock-audit-readd-btn). Clicking re-add produced toast '5 units for QA-BADGE-0001 added back to the warehouse.'; dialog then showed 'Verified units restored: 5 (5)' and after reload the red pill and banner were gone. In Reversals tab (ReversalsLog), QA-BADGE-0001 shows green 'Verified' badge (reversal-stock-verified-QA-BADGE-0001) as expected post re-add. All Mongo cleanup performed: deleted the delivery, its item, decremented and deleted the newly created distributor_stock row (qty went 5→0, created today), and deleted the stock_movements record with reference QA-BADGE-0001.

issues: Default Time Period filter is 'This Month' which hid the qualifying reversed delivery (Jun 2026) on a September system date — QA needed to change to 'Last 6 Months' before the banner/pill became visible. Consider surfacing the banner regardless of time filter, or default the range wide enough to include recent reversed items.

critical_code_review_comments: isStockRestoreUnverified helper in DeliveriesTab.jsx only reads deliveries within the current Time Period window; the alert banner can be missed if the reversed delivery falls outside 'This Month'. Consider a global un-verified-count fetch decoupled from list pagination.

Reversals log rendered a 'Verified' badge only after full page reload; if the user re-adds from the audit dialog the ReversalsLog does not appear to be re-fetched in real time — okay but worth polishing.
seed_data_creation: None — cleanup of pre-seeded QA-BADGE-0001 delivery, its item, the newly-created distributor_stock row and the stock_movements 'QA-BADGE-0001' entry was performed.
